title: PyTorch Geometric issue: Segmentation fault (core dumped)
author: giuseppeantoniomotisi

comments.author: giuseppeantoniomotisi
comments.body: I reinstalled all packages with a older version of PyTorch (2.0.0) and without installing other dependencies. I got a warning regarding torch-scatter (that was required in training for speed-up the process) but it works, so anyway
